svg.aria-label: Notes from team members, fellows and guest writers meet one bar: would an assistant cite it over a generic page, with firsthand data, a verdict worth disputing, or an angle nobody else has. A note that clears it goes to the lead shelf. A useful but generic note becomes depth under topic pages. An overlapping or stale note is merged or drafted and its URL redirects. Nothing is deleted.
svg.text: what earns a page on memo
Nothing is deleted. A retired page becomes a draft and its URL redirects.
A fact we cannot re-prove keeps its old value under a dated snapshot line.
